title: Screen transform + Smooth camera shake plugin for RPG Maker MZ (rotate / skew / scale / move)

posts.author: ODUE
posts.body:
ODUE_screenTransform
​
This plugin allows you to transform (scale / rotate / skew / move) the screen / camera with animations.
FEATURES:
- Smooth camera shake (New! Added 10.8.2024)
- Scale screen
- Rotate screen
- Move screen
- Skew screen
- Customize pivot point / duration / easing etc.
- Choose what parts to transform (HUD, pictures or only map)
Guide:
Download:
https://github.com/00due/RMMZ-ScreenTransform
Please send your issues / feature requests to the GitHub page if possible!
This makes my life a lot easier, since it's faster for me to check the issues on GitHub.
After downloading, move the `ODUE_screenTransform.js` file into `<your project's folder>/js/plugins`
Using the plugin:
- You can use the plugin commands to transform the screen.
- Use "Wait..." command to manually wait for animation.
Terms of use:
1. You must give credit to ODUE
2. You can freely edit this plugin to your needs. However, you must still credit me.
3. This plugin is free for commercial and non-commercial projects.
4. This plugin is provided as is. I'm not responsible for anything you make with this plugin.
5. You can send feature requests to me on platforms such as Reddit (to u/SanttuPOIKA----).
However, I have no obligation to fulfill your requests.
